title: Variant of the local criterion of flatness
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] ($\varphi(\mathfrak m_R)\subseteq\mathfrak m_S$), let $I\subsetneq R$ be a proper ideal and let $M$ be a finitely generated $S$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], regarded as an $R$-module via $\varphi$. Assume (1) the $R$-linear multiplication map $I\otimes_RM\to M$, $a\otimes x\mapsto\varphi(a)x$, is injective (by Stacks, Remark 00M6, its kernel is $\mathrm{Tor}_1^R(M,R/I)$, so this is the hypothesis $\mathrm{Tor}_1^R(M,R/I)=0$), and (2) $M/IM$ is a flat $R/I$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Then $M$ is a flat $R$-module.
